clue.text: Young mammal breaking free on rail limited earwig

parts.note: f.o.r. is the shipping abbreviation for free on rail
a kit is a young fox, ferret or similar animal
in law an estate in tail is one limited to certain heirs, so tail can mean limited

explanation.surface: A young creature bursts free and limits the rail somehow, an earwig nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: FOR is the trade abbreviation 'free on rail', which 'breaking' splits around KIT; TAIL as 'limited' is the legal sense, as in fee tail.
explanation.definitionFit: Forkit-tail is a Scots dialect name for the insect, from its forked pincers at the rear.

clue.text: Land tenure affected Algonkin farm

indicators.note: affected means the letters of the two words are disturbed and reformed

explanation.surface: A farm belonging to Algonkin people was affected by a change of land rights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' is the anagram signal for ALGONKIN FARM.
explanation.definitionFit: Frankalmoign was a medieval tenure by which a religious body held land in return for prayers.

clue.text: Cat, one of a number found in pound

definitions.meaning: the snow leopard is also called by this name

definitions.text: one of a number found in pound
definitions.meaning: sixteen of these weight units make up an avoirdupois pound

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the snow leopard and a unit of weight, sixteen to the pound.

clue.text: Stomachs extracting breadth from foods

indicators.note: extracting means a letter is pulled out of the word for foods

parts.note: breads are foods

explanation.surface: Taking breadth out of what we eat leaves our stomachs.
explanation.definitionFit: Read is the fourth stomach of a ruminant, the abomasum, so the plural means such stomachs.

clue.text: Enjoying success working with computers?

definitions.meaning: to be in the running or doing well
IN plus IT, information technology, so employed in computing

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means being in contention, and also, split as in plus IT, employed in information technology.

clue.text: It preps those heading towards actual exam after revision?

definitions.text: It preps those heading towards actual exam after revision?

indicators.note: after revision means the letters are revised into a fresh order
heading means the front letter of each of the four following words is taken

explanation.surface: A mock exam gets candidates ready for the real one once they have revised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading' takes T, T, A, E from those, towards, actual, exam; 'after revision' rearranges them with PREPS. The whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice paper prepares pupils for the real examination, which is what the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Part of debate MP opposed in time

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A parliamentary debate features an MP who opposed the motion in due course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of' signals letters inside 'debate MP opposed'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian musical direction tells players to return to the original tempo, keeping strict time.

clue.text: Starts to layer ice just like Elsa?

indicators.note: Starts to means the opening letters of the next two words are taken

parts.note: just means only

explanation.surface: An ice queen begins layering frost, the very picture of Elsa.
explanation.walkthrough: Elsa is not the Frozen princess but the lioness of Born Free.
explanation.definitionFit: Elsa was the lioness of Born Free, so behaving in the manner of a big cat fits.

clue.text: Good friend trapping a spider?

indicators.note: trapping means the article is caught inside the word for a close pal

parts.note: a bestie is a best friend

explanation.surface: A close pal catches a spider in a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scots word for a small creature or bug, of which a spider is an example, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Cockroaches blighted North Sea port

indicators.note: blighted means the words are spoiled and their letters reshuffled

explanation.surface: Insect pests infest a run-down harbour town on the North Sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blighted' is the anagram signal for NORTH SEA PORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambers counts cockroaches among the order of straight-winged insects with grasshoppers and crickets.

clue.text: Spoke about reflex that is repentance

indicators.note: about means the ladder bar goes around the other piece

parts.note: a rung is a spoke or crossbar of a ladder or chair

indicators.note: reflex means bent back, so the abbreviation is turned around

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone spoke about a reflex reaction that showed regret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spoke' is not the past of speak but a ladder bar; 'reflex' turns the abbreviation for that is, and 'about' wraps the bar round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling sorry or regretful is a noun sense matching penitence.

clue.text: Shakespearean to fade after latest attack

indicators.note: after means the archaic verb follows the word for fashionable

parts.note: in means fashionable or the latest thing
vade is a Shakespearean form of fade

explanation.surface: An old poet's word for fading follows the newest assault.
explanation.definitionFit: To invade is to enter hostile territory by force, a synonym of assault.

clue.text: Aid for mountaineers scaling face of Eiger test

indicators.note: face of means the front letter of the mountain name is taken

parts.note: someone who puts things to the test is one who makes an attempt or trial

explanation.surface: Climbers take a piece of kit to the Eiger's north face as a trial.
explanation.definitionFit: An étrier is a short rope ladder used by climbers on steep rock.

clue.text: Run away from a fantasy world's liar

indicators.note: away from means a letter is removed from the land of fantasy

parts.note: Narnia is the fantasy world of C. S. Lewis's novels
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Escaping a fantasy land, someone is exposed as a fibber.
explanation.walkthrough: Ananias is the man in Acts struck dead for lying, so his name means a liar.
explanation.definitionFit: Ananias in the Acts of the Apostles lied about money and died, so the name stands for a fibber.

clue.text: German craft beers primarily ordinary in taste

indicators.note: in means the two letters go inside the word for taste

parts.note: to taste food is to eat it

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: German-brewed beers are mainly ordinary in flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: An E-boat was a fast German motor torpedo boat of the Second World War.

clue.text: Succulent chilli pepper wrapped in cabbage

indicators.note: wrapped in means the pepper is enclosed by the leafy green

parts.note: kale is a kind of cabbage
ancho is a dried poblano chilli

explanation.surface: A tasty chilli parcel is rolled up in cabbage leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Kalanchoe is a genus of fleshy-leaved plants grown as houseplants.

clue.text: Become engaged hugging new intimate briefly

indicators.note: hugging means the word for gears meshing wraps around the letter

parts.note: gears mesh when they become engaged

explanation.surface: A couple get engaged, hugging their new close friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Become engaged' is about gear teeth, not marriage; 'intimate briefly' is a verb, to hint.
explanation.definitionFit: Mensh is a colloquial shortening of mention, and to intimate is to hint or mention.

clue.text: Ancient emperor coming back to destroy king

indicators.note: coming back means the whole string is read in reverse

parts.note: to rase is to raze or destroy
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: An old emperor returns to overthrow a king.
explanation.definitionFit: Kesar is a Spenserian form of kaiser, a title for an emperor.

clue.text: Sicilian contract liable to nobble partner, principle of omerta?

indicators.note: to nobble means the word for liable seizes the friend inside it

parts.note: apt means liable or likely
a pal is a partner or mate

indicators.note: principle is read as the principal or first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A Mafia deal may nobble a partner, following the code of silence.
explanation.walkthrough: Omertà is the Mafia's code of silence; 'principle of' is a play on principal, giving its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Appalto is an Italian word for a contract or monopoly, here a Sicilian one.

clue.text: A school of fish almost completely lacking ventral fins

parts.note: a pod is a school, especially of whales or fish

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: all means completely

explanation.surface: A school of fish nearly entirely lacks belly fins.
explanation.definitionFit: Apodal means footless, used of fish without the paired pelvic fins.

clue.text: Investigation involving League? One side of Manchester's plight

indicators.note: involving means the inquiry wraps around the letter

parts.note: a probe is an investigation

indicators.note: One side of means the leading letter of the city name is taken

explanation.surface: An inquiry into the league reveals trouble at one Manchester club.
explanation.definitionFit: A plight is a difficult situation, as is a trouble or difficulty.

clue.text: Goddess is reflecting violent emotion — not weak

indicators.note: reflecting means the shortened word is mirrored, read backwards
not means the letter for weak is dropped

parts.note: wrath is violent anger

explanation.surface: A goddess reflects on her violent anger, which is anything but weak.
explanation.walkthrough: Ishtar was the Babylonian goddess of love and war; 'not' and 'reflecting' work on the anger word, which follows the clue's own IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Ishtar was the Babylonian deity of love and war.

clue.text: Thoroughly beat struggling nation

indicators.note: struggling means the letters of the word are in disorder

explanation.surface: A struggling nation is soundly defeated.
explanation.definitionFit: Anoint is a dialect or ironic word meaning to thrash, as in giving a good drubbing.

clue.text: Extensive gold, that which is stolen previously

parts.note: main can mean extensive or vast, as in the main ocean
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: An extensive gold hoard turns out to have been stolen.
explanation.definitionFit: Mainor is an archaic legal word for stolen goods found in the thief's hand.

clue.text: Cooking pot's name with handle on one end

definitions.text: Cooking pot's name with handle on one end

indicators.note: Cooking means the letters are stirred up into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe giving no letter

indicators.note: on one end means the final letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: A cooking pot is named for having a handle at one end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on one end' takes E from handle; 'Cooking' rearranges it with POTS and N. The whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A posnet is an old small cooking vessel with a handle and three feet.

clue.text: Alpine forest inspiring one

indicators.note: inspiring means breathing in, so the forest word takes the other inside

parts.note: monte is a word for wooded mountain country
an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: An alpine forest inspires a lone visitor.
explanation.definitionFit: Montane means of mountainous country, as alpine does.

clue.text: Cause to fret getting hot in greasy spoon?

indicators.note: in means the letter goes inside the eating place

parts.note: a greasy spoon is a cheap British cafe serving fried food
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone gets irritated by the heat inside a cheap diner.
explanation.definitionFit: To chafe is to irritate or vex, making someone fret.

clue.text: Annan's well active whirlpool

parts.note: A is the grammatical abbreviation for active
weel is a Scots word for a whirlpool

explanation.surface: In a Scottish town, a well becomes an active whirlpool.
explanation.walkthrough: Annan is a town in south-west Scotland, so 'Annan's' flags a Scots word.
explanation.definitionFit: Aweel is a Scots interjection equivalent to 'oh well'.

clue.text: Old parchment previously left behind

indicators.note: behind means the letter comes after the word for previously

parts.note: fore means before or previously

explanation.surface: An ancient parchment was left behind earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: Forel was a kind of parchment used for book covers.

clue.text: Old halfpennies I toss over on the counter

indicators.note: on the counter means running counter, against the usual direction

parts.note: to lob is to toss
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Someone flips old coins across the shop counter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the counter' turns I, LOB, O into the answer; 'counter' looks like a shop's but means contrary.
explanation.definitionFit: The obol was a small Greek coin, and in Britain the name was used for a halfpenny.

clue.text: Stump having worms around

indicators.note: around means the word is turned back to front

parts.note: bots are parasitic larvae, worms of the botfly

explanation.surface: A tree stump is crawling with worms.
explanation.definitionFit: Stob is a dialect word for a stake or stump.

clue.text: Trojan horse nearly overturned after one and one-third of a mile (approx)

indicators.note: after means the reversed horse comes behind the other pieces

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
the li is a Chinese unit of distance of about a third of a mile

indicators.note: overturned means the shortened horse is turned upside down, read backwards
nearly means the final letter is lost

parts.note: a nag is a horse

explanation.surface: The Trojan horse nearly toppled after travelling over a mile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' cuts NAG to NA and 'overturned' makes AN; the li is a Chinese distance unit of roughly 0.31 miles.
explanation.definitionFit: Ilian means of Ilium, that is of Troy.

clue.text: Greek goddess going outside to polish off rebuffed courtesan

indicators.note: going outside means the goddess surrounds the other piece

parts.note: Hera was the queen of the Greek gods

indicators.note: rebuffed means pushed back, so the word is reversed

parts.note: to eat is to polish off food

explanation.surface: A Greek goddess steps out to finish off a rejected courtesan.
explanation.walkthrough: Hetaerae were educated companions in classical Athens; 'rebuffed' turns the eating word and 'going outside' sets the goddess around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A hetaera was a highly educated companion or mistress in ancient Greece.

clue.text: Penguin — refined fellow with a pair of spectacles?

parts.note: a gent is a gentleman, a refined fellow
two round lenses look like a pair of letter Os

explanation.surface: A dapper penguin wears glasses like a gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: The gentoo is a species of penguin of the Antarctic region.

clue.text: Something smelly by ditch in country lane

parts.note: BO is body odour
reen is a dialect word for a drainage ditch

explanation.surface: Something smells by the ditch on a rural lane.
explanation.definitionFit: Boreen is an Irish word for a narrow country road.

clue.text: Uncle's sign half over?

definitions.meaning: Uncle is British slang for a pawnbroker, whose shop displays three golden balls
in cricket an over is six deliveries, so half of one is that many

explanation.walkthrough: Uncle is old British slang for a pawnbroker; a cricket over has six balls.
explanation.definitionFit: The pawnbroker's emblem is three gilt spheres, and half a six-delivery cricket over is the same count.
